item.title: Anti-Zionist activists stage blood libel display near White House
item.description: Actors dressed as Netanyahu, Trump and Epstein dismember and devour fake dead baby, rehashing trope that has caused mass violence against Jews for centuries The post Anti-Zionist activists stage blood libel display near White House appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Despite war, Israel releases ‘Michelle,’ its 2026 Eurovision song
item.description: Song to be performed by Noam Bettan at contest in Vienna this May is largely in Hebrew and French, with one verse in English, and 'touches on the whole spectrum of emotions' The post Despite war, Israel releases ‘Michelle,’ its 2026 Eurovision song appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Novelty no more, Team Israel goes to bat for local game with return to World Baseball Classic
item.description: Built mainly around American Jewish players, the team returning to the global tourney this week has become a symbol of Jewish identity and a driver for the sport's growth at home The post Novelty no more, Team Israel goes to bat for local game with return to World Baseball Classic appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: In safety precaution, Israel to bar Friday Ramadan prayers at Temple Mount amid Iran war
item.description: Israeli authorities stress that all holy sites in Jerusalem's Old City are closed to worshippers, as gatherings remain capped at 50 people despite easing of restrictions The post In safety precaution, Israel to bar Friday Ramadan prayers at Temple Mount amid Iran war appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: In shadow of war, Israel’s Winter Paralympian is ready to ski – but not on Shabbat
item.description: Sheina Vaspi to skip two events at 2026 Milano Cortina Games due to Shabbat observance, but vows to ensure Israeli flag flies at Paralympic Games The post In shadow of war, Israel’s Winter Paralympian is ready to ski – but not on Shabbat appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US, Israel say Iran missile fire down, most launchers taken out as offensive ramps up
item.description: Hegseth says firepower set to surge as B-2s start dropping heavy bombs on missile sites deep underground; Zamir says new phase will target regime's foundations; cluster warhead fired at central Israel in late night attack The post US, Israel say Iran missile fire down, most launchers taken out as offensive ramps up appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US probe said to indicate American forces likely launched strike that hit Iran girls school
item.description: Officials stress US military investigators haven't yet reached final conclusion or completed investigation, which Hegseth confirms: 'We, of course, never target civilian targets' The post US probe said to indicate American forces likely launched strike that hit Iran girls school appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: GOP senator helps forcibly remove protester shouting ‘no one wants to fight for Israel’
item.description: US Capitol Police say demonstrator, a Green Party candidate in North Carolina, 'put everyone in a dangerous position by violently resisting and fighting our attempts to remove him' The post GOP senator helps forcibly remove protester shouting ‘no one wants to fight for Israel’ appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Iranians tell ToI they praise Israel, US for Khamenei’s end, but fear what’s next
item.description: Speaking via activist, residents thank Netanyahu and Trump, recounting street celebrations after ayatollah killed, while describing unease over Iran's future amid ongoing bombardment The post Iranians tell ToI they praise Israel, US for Khamenei’s end, but fear what’s next appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Israeli researchers find cannabis compounds could lead to 1st drug for fatty liver disease
item.description: As 1 out of every 3 adults worldwide suffers from the condition, Hebrew University scientists use non-psychoactive substances to change how the organ manages energy and cleans itself The post Israeli researchers find cannabis compounds could lead to 1st drug for fatty liver disease appeared first on The Times of Israel.
